stem: Ben wants to add support to his introductory paragraph. Which of the following should be added after sentence 3 to accomplish this goal?

options.label: A
options.text: Both children and their parents climb all around the intricate wonderland that is found in St. Louis, Missouri.

options.label: B
options.text: Others position themselves at the top of a long slide that reaches down ten stories inside the building.

options.label: C
options.text: This is an amazing museum, and there should be many more like this across the country.

options.label: D
options.text: This Ferris wheel is from long ago, and it is an incredible presence as it spins on the rooftop of this building.
